meta.title: Marketplace
meta.description: Submit offers and requirements to the Ponte marketplace. Every published opportunity is checked by Ponte, and the public record states which evidence Ponte checked and what remains unverified.

hero.heading: Every published opportunity checked by Ponte.
hero.intro: Post what you sell or what you need, free. AI and the desk verify every listing before it goes live, you stay anonymous until both sides agree to connect, and connecting costs nothing. Want the deal managed end to end? The desk steps in on a success fee or retainer, only when you ask.

vetted.title: Checked before live
vetted.body: The public record states which evidence Ponte checked and what remains unverified.

anonymous.title: Anonymized always
anonymous.body: Counterparties see the deal, never your name, until both sides agree to connect. Then you each receive the other's contact.

free.title: Free to trade
free.body: Posting, browsing and connecting cost nothing. Bring in the desk only if you want the deal managed end to end, on a success fee or retainer.

how.heading: Five steps. One rule: checked before introduced.

board.heading: {count, plural, one {# checked listing on the board.} other {# checked listings on the board.}}
board.headingLive: Checked listings, live on the board.
board.empty: The board opens once the first listings clear Ponte's checks. Submissions are open now, and early listings get the most attention when it goes live.
board.signInToRead: Sign in to read the full listing.

mine.heading: Where things stand.
mine.empty: Your first listing takes five minutes: the product, the terms, and any documents that prove you are serious. Ponte checks it and publishes it from there.

connect.request: A member wants to connect. Accept and you both receive each other's contact. Free.
connect.requestNumbered: A member wants to connect ({n}). Accept and you both receive each other's contact. Free.

cta.heading: Prefer to talk it through first?
cta.body: Bring the deal to the desk directly and we will scope it with you.

meta.title: New listing
meta.description: Build your offer or requirement, preview it as it will appear on the board, then publish it.

new.heading: Build it. See it. Publish it.
new.intro: No account needed to build your listing and preview it exactly as it will appear on the board. You sign in only when you publish.

detail.assurance: Checked automatically for completeness, quality and risk before going live. Counterparties stay anonymous until both sides agree to connect; connecting is free.
detail.signInToRead: Sign in free to read the full listing.
detail.machineTranslation: Machine translation. The original wording governs.
detail.footer: Have something to sell or source yourself? <link>Build your listing in three steps</link>, no account needed until you publish.
